news.aTitleOther: {name} win the {comp} with {pts} points from {p} games.{pos_k}
news.takeoverTight: {club}'s new owners have arrived with accountants. Word is their best players can be had, at the right price.
news.takeoverTightMine: The deal is done. The new owners' first act was an audit, and their second a memo. Your transfer budget is cut to {budget} and every contract will be "reviewed for value". The new chairman will be watching every result.
news.takeoverRich: The consortium has completed its purchase of {club} and promised fresh investment straight away. {short} will be spending this summer.
news.takeoverRichMine: Your new owner walked the training ground on day one and left a message with your secretary. The transfer budget is up {boost} and the wage ceiling has gone up with it. Mediocrity is no longer on the menu. The next two months are your audition.
news.predTitle: {club} are everyone's title pick. Anything less will be called a failure.
news.predPlayoffs: {club} are tipped for the play-offs. The pressure starts on day one.
news.predMid: {club} are pegged for mid-table. "Solid, unspectacular" is the general view.
news.predLast: The pundits have {club} dead last. The wooden spoon talk has started already.
news.predRelegation: {club} are among the favourites for relegation. Nobody is expecting much.
news.predBottom: {club} are tipped for the bottom half, and nobody outside the club is arguing.
news.testimonialDay: {stadium} was full for {player}'s testimonial{scored_k}. He insisted the gate ({gate}) goes to the club. One more season in the shirt to come.
news.oldBoyWeWonSubj: Old boy {player} crosses against his former club
news.oldBoyWeWon: {player}, once of this parish, went over for {opp}. No celebration, just a nod to the away end. The result went your way, so the home crowd could afford to clap.
news.oldBoyWeLostSubj: Old boy {player} crosses against his former club
news.oldBoyWeLost: Of course it was him. {player} - {apps} appearances in your colours before he left - crossed against his old club and the ground knew it was coming.
news.firstCap: {player} won a first Test cap for {nationThe_k} this week. Somebody at the club is already looking for a frame.
news.capMilestone: {player} brought up his {n_o} cap for {nationThe_k} this week. Special jersey, and a guard of honour when he got back to training.

suspended.one: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} match following his red card. He will be unavailable until the ban is served.
suspended.other: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} matches following his red card. He will be unavailable until the ban is served.

news.tottingUp: {n} yellow cards this season have earned {player} a one-match suspension under the league's totting-up rule.
news.debutAcademySubj: A debut to tell his grandkids about: {player}
news.debutAcademy: {player} ({age}, {pos}) came through the academy and made his first-team debut today.{scored_k}{motm_k} The press box gave him {rating}. The supporters will have a song for him by Tuesday.
news.debutSigning: First competitive appearance for {player} ({pos}) since signing, and he made it count.{scored_k}{motm_k} Rated {rating} by the press box.
news.debutMotm: The sponsors gave him the match award before he had learned everyone's names.
news.mentorSpread: {name} has two kids under his wing and he mentioned it after training. Politely, but he mentioned it. The extras are shared now, so each lad is learning at about three-quarter speed.
news.scoutWhyThin: one injury from a crisis there
news.scoutWhyOld: {who} is {yrs} and not getting any quicker
news.scoutWhyWeakest: the weakest shirt in the side
news.trBestA: Best on the grass: {name} - sharp all week.
news.trBestB: {name} trained like the ball was on a string. Best of the week by a distance.
news.trBestC: The staff vote for the week's best on the paddock was unanimous: {name}.
news.trBestD: {name} finished every drill first and every session smiling. Ominous for the opposition.
news.trPushA: Knocking on the door: {name} is training like a man who wants the shirt.
news.trPushB: {name} spent the week making the selection meeting awkward. Good.
news.trPushC: If team sheets were picked on a Tuesday, {name} starts this weekend.
news.trKidA: From the academy pitches: the coaches keep mentioning {name}. One for the notebook.
news.trKidB: {name} trained up with the seniors on Thursday and did not look out of place.
news.trKidC: The academy staff have started staying late to watch {name}. That usually means something.
news.trFocus: Focus this week: {prep_k} work, as ordered.
news.trNoPrep: No match preparation set. The week ran on autopilot.
news.mrRout1: {us} were out of sight early and never let up.
news.mrRout2: {opp} will not want to watch that back. Total control, first minute to last.
news.mrRout3: One of those afternoons when everything you drew on the whiteboard actually happened.
news.mrComfort1: Comfortable. The pack had control from the first scrum.
news.mrComfort2: Job done. Ahead early, managed from there, nobody hurt.
news.mrComfort3: The scoreboard says comfortable. The forwards' knuckles say earned.
news.mrNarrow1: Nervy to the last whistle. A win is a win.
news.mrNarrow2: Not pretty. The dressing room sang anyway.
news.mrNarrow3: Down to the last few minutes. Your lot held their nerve.
news.mrDraw1: Honours even, and nobody quite sure how to feel about it.
news.mrDraw2: A draw that will feel like two points dropped or one rescued, depending on the day you had.
news.mrDraw3: All square. The handshakes were polite and nobody meant them.
news.mrNearMiss1: Wrong side of a close one. That'll sting for a few days.
news.mrNearMiss2: One more phase, one more kick, and it was yours. That's what hurts.
news.mrNearMiss3: Beaten, barely. The review will find three plays that would have flipped it.
news.mrBeaten1: Long video session on Monday. Nobody's looking forward to it.
news.mrBeaten2: {opp} were better in every department, and the score was honest about it.
news.mrBeaten3: Second to everything. Monday's training will not be gentle.
news.appealUpheld: The panel reviewed the footage frame by frame and knocked a match off the suspension. {rest_k}
news.appealFreeToPlay: He is free to play this weekend.

appealDismissed.one: The panel called the challenge "without merit" and added a match for its trouble. The chairman's jaw tightens upstairs. {n} match to serve.
appealDismissed.other: The panel called the challenge "without merit" and added a match for its trouble. The chairman's jaw tightens upstairs. {n} matches to serve.

news.campHeatSubj: Camp report: sharp, brown and slightly broken
news.campHeat: A week of double sessions in serious heat. The GPS numbers are the best the staff have ever logged in pre-season, and the group came home tighter than they went. {cost} well spent, probably.
news.campHomeSubj: Community week: the supporters turn out
news.campHome: Open training drew a four-figure crowd on a Tuesday. The players visited every school in the area and every junior club got a coaching session. It cost next to nothing.
news.campTour: Two exhibition matches, three time zones, one very happy sponsor and {fee} in the bank. The supporters grumble about a pre-season spent in departure lounges, and the squad starts the year with heavy legs.
news.toneSwaggerSubj: Swagger alert: is all that praise going to their heads?
news.toneSwagger: Your players can't stop telling the press how good they are. They got that from you. The assistant's note is blunt: "Training tempo has dipped. They think they only need to turn up." Until the tone changes, expect it to show on a Saturday.
news.toneBruisedSubj: Dressing room bruised by public criticism
news.toneBruised: Weeks of hard words in press conferences have landed. Senior players are said to be "sick of being thrown under the bus", and morale has dropped across the squad.
news.grudgePreContract: they signed {player} on a pre-contract under our noses
news.grudgeBoiledOver: the last meeting boiled over, with {cards} cards and a tunnel full of pushing
news.grudgeBrokeHeartsFinal: they broke our hearts in the {comp_k} final
news.grudgeBrokeHeartsSemi: they broke our hearts in the {comp_k} semi-final
news.riftContact: a flashpoint in Tuesday's contact session
news.riftDefRead: a row over a missed defensive read
news.riftBustUp: a training-ground bust-up witnessed by the whole squad
news.riftGym: a disagreement that started at the gym and followed them onto the pitch
news.transferDoneFree: {to} have completed the signing of {player}, who was without a club. The {age}-year-old has agreed terms of {wage}/week until {until}.
news.wcDrawW:
The World Championship pools are set, seeded from the world rankings. Top seeds: {top_l}.
Four pools, four nations each, and somewhere in there a group of death.
news.forfeit: {loser} could not field ten fit players and the match is awarded to {winner}, 28-0 with the try bonus. A squad that thin is a matter for the board.
news.forfeitSubj: Walkover: {loser} could not raise a side
news.playedOut: The match was left running at {min}'. Your assistant saw it out from there, making the changes and kicking for the posts when the chance came. Full time: {home} {hs}-{as} {away}.
news.boardInjection: The board have voted the funds through: {amount} goes into the transfer budget straight away, and the wages that come with it are covered from upstairs until the summer. The minutes record one condition: spend it like it matters.
news.charterSubj: New ownership: the wage law no longer applies
news.charter: The paperwork is signed and the lawyers have gone home. {club} are no longer bound by the league's salary cap. No ceiling, and nothing the league can fine. The league's statement runs to one short paragraph. Agents have been ringing since breakfast.
news.physioFavourSubj: The sponsor's consultant: {player} ahead of schedule

physioFavour.one: The club's shirt sponsor paid for a consultant to look at {player}'s {injury_k}. A different rehab plan should cut a week off the lay-off.
physioFavour.other: The club's shirt sponsor paid for a consultant to look at {player}'s {injury_k}. A different rehab plan should cut {n} weeks off the lay-off.

news.townCollection: The supporters' trust organised a collection for {club}: {amount}, in coins and notes and one farmer's cheque, handed over before training. {city} does not intend to lose this club.
news.healSubj: The retreat: a clean bill of health
news.heal: The specialist retreat has done its job: {n} of the squad came back with a clean bill of health. Every injury cleared. Match sharpness still has to come back the old way, on a Saturday.
news.estate: The contractors have gone and the scaffolding with them: every facility at {club} is now at its ceiling. Nine world-class facilities, with running costs to match. The books will feel those every week.
news.pinnacle: Your name has gone to the federations, with a full dossier of your work attached. These things move quickly once they move at all: expect an approach within a fortnight.
news.dressingDownSubj: Dressing room whispers: {player} unhappy after dressing-down
news.dressingDown: Word has leaked that {player} was hauled in front of the coach over his recent form - and didn't take it well. Team-mates say he trained on his own on Tuesday.
news.boardPushedSubj: FORMAL WARNING: the board's answer stands
news.boardPushed: You were given an answer and came back to the door anyway. The board takes that as a challenge to its authority and has said so in writing. The answer hasn't changed, its confidence in your judgement has taken a heavy knock, and every repeat of this conversation will cost you more.
news.sackedPushed: Warned in writing, and back at the boardroom door within the month anyway. The board decided the club needed a manager who could hear the word no. {era} The story of how it ended will follow you to your next job.
news.dreamRefocus: You set out to {dream_k}, and you've done it. That stays on the record for good. When you're ready, pick a new dream.
news.sponsorEnded: {short} and {sponsor} have parted ways before the end of the {slot_k} deal, at the club's request. The money stops straight away. Three new sponsors have already been in touch about the slot, and their terms vary: some will pay well for a club back on the market, some will make you pay for the gap.
news.natAppointed: It's official: you are the head coach of {nat_k}. Every trophy you win in the Test windows and championships goes in your cabinet, and your assistant takes the club whenever your country plays. One decision left: whether you carry on at the club.
news.natAppointedOnly: It's official: you are the head coach of {nat_k}. Every trophy they win goes in your cabinet, and with no club to run, the country gets your whole week.
news.fanSoldStar: {player} has gone to {to} and {club}'s support are not taking it well: the forums say this is a club selling its best and buying nobody, and one supporter has changed his profile picture to a black square. Fan mood down {n}.
news.fanSoldIcon: There is a difference between selling a player and selling one of their own, and {club}'s support know which this is. {player} has joined {to}. There is a bedsheet on the fence, and the phone-in ran ninety minutes with nobody defending it. Fan mood down {n}.
news.fanSignedStarSubj: {player} signs - and the supporters have noticed
news.fanSignedStar: {player} is a {club} player. The announcement video has been watched more times than the club has ever sold tickets, the club shop has sold out of the letters in his name, and a local bakery is doing a limited-edition pastry nobody can describe. Fan mood is up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanSignedIconSubj: THEY'VE ONLY GONE AND SIGNED HIM: {player}
news.fanSignedIcon: There were people on the streets. Actual people, on a Tuesday. {player} has signed for {club} and {city} has lost all proportion: two babies named after the manager, a man tattooed somewhere he will regret, the club song eleven times before lunch. Fan mood up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanRivalNamed: In the dressing room the mood is more complicated: {rival} has just watched his shirt get a great deal harder to keep.
news.fanRivalNone: Nobody in the squad plays where he plays, which is exactly why he was signed.
news.fanRumble: Not a campaign yet, more a tone. {boss} is being discussed rather than backed, the forum thread is nine pages long, and the word "direction" is coming up a lot.
news.fanRumbleV2: Nothing organised, just a mood. The supporters' podcast spent twenty minutes on {boss} this week and none of it on tactics. A couple of wins would change the subject.
news.fanRumbleV3: The letters page has turned on {club}. Questions about {boss} are still being asked politely, for now.
news.fanBanners: A section of the {club} support has organised: banners in the away end's eyeline, a hashtag, a petition with more names than the ground holds. The board have been asked about it twice this week and answered carefully both times. It costs {boss} confidence every week it runs.
news.fanPlane: They hired a plane. It flew over {stadium} for eleven minutes trailing a message about {boss}, and that photograph is now the picture every outlet uses for this club. The directors are no longer asked whether they back the manager. They are asked when.
news.fanForgiven: The banners are gone, the thread has died, and the singing on Saturday started before kick-off rather than after the first score. {club}'s support have decided they are behind {boss} after all. The pressure is off, for now.
news.fanForgivenV2: Whatever was being said about {boss} on the phone-ins has stopped. {club}'s support turned up early, stayed late and sang throughout. That buys some credit, if not a blank cheque.
news.fanForgivenV3Subj: Peace breaks out on the terraces
news.fanForgivenV3: The thread about {boss} has gone quiet and the season-ticket queue has not. {club}'s support are back behind the team, and the board have noticed the difference in the stands.
news.upStormSubj: The gale took the South Stand tarpaulin
news.upStorm: Three days of wind and {stadium} has lost most of the covering on the South Stand, two advertising boards and, for reasons the groundsman cannot explain, a wheelie bin that was later found in the car park of a garden centre. The repair comes to {amount}. The bin has been returned.
news.upRoof: The five-year survey on {stadium} came back with the word "urgent" in it more times than anybody would like. Steelwork, guttering and a section of cladding that has apparently been held on by paint since the nineties. {amount}, and the surveyor would like it known that he did warn them.
news.upPipeSubj: A burst pipe under the away changing room
news.upPipe: It went at four in the morning, which is the only good news in the story, and the away changing room at {stadium} spent six hours as a paddling pool. New flooring, new benches, and a plumber who kept saying "well there's your problem" without ever specifying what it was. {amount}.
news.upFloodlightsSubj: Two floodlight columns fail the inspection
news.upFloodlights: The lighting engineer walked round {stadium} with a clipboard and a look, and two columns did not pass. Replacement heads, a crane for a day, and a Tuesday night fixture that came within an hour of being played in what he cheerfully called "heritage lighting". {amount}.
news.upPitchSubj: The pitch has to be relaid
news.upPitch: The drainage has given up, the far corner has been more mud than grass since November, and the groundsman has started referring to it as "the bog" in official documents. A full hybrid relay at {stadium}: {amount}. The verdict from the grounds staff is that it will be worth it. They are right, and they will not stop saying it.
news.upForkliftSubj: A forklift, a hospitality suite, and a very quiet meeting
news.upForklift: Nobody has been named. Everybody knows. A forklift reversed through the partition wall of the hospitality suite at {stadium} on a Thursday afternoon, and the club is now short one partition wall, one drinks fridge and a print of the 1998 squad that the chairman was fond of. {amount}, and a new policy about who may drive what.
news.upBadger: A protected species has taken a serious interest in the drainage at {stadium}, and the law is extremely clear about who has to move. Ecologist, licence, exclusion fencing and a specialist relocation: {amount}. The groundsman has stopped speaking to anyone about it.
news.upDinnerSubj: The sportsman's dinner went off like a rocket
news.upDinner: Sold out in nine hours, a comedian who was funnier than he was expensive, and an auction that got completely out of hand when two local builders started bidding against each other for a signed shirt neither of them wanted. {club} are {amount} better off and the builders are no longer speaking.
news.upBeerFestSubj: The beer festival was rained on for three days
news.upBeerFest: Two hundred barrels, a marquee, a folk duo, and the wettest weekend since records began at {stadium}. The marquee held. The car park did not. What was budgeted as the summer's big earner is a loss of {amount}, and there is a great deal of beer in the cellar that somebody will have to drink.
news.upWeddingSubj: The function room is booked out until June
news.upWedding: Somebody in the commercial department had the idea of marketing {stadium} for weddings, and it has worked far better than anyone expected. Every Saturday is spoken for, the club has bought a second dance floor, and the groundsman has been asked twice whether the pitch can be walked on in heels. {amount} to the good.
news.upConcertSubj: A stadium concert, and the grass will forgive us
news.upConcert: Forty thousand people, one very famous act, and a stage build that took eleven days. {stadium} banks {amount}, the groundsman has aged visibly, and the far touchline will be a slightly different colour until March. The board have already asked when the next one is.
news.upFunRunSubj: The fun run raised more than expected
news.upFunRun: Fourteen hundred people ran round {stadium} in fancy dress on a Sunday morning. A man in a full front-row scrum costume, alone, finished in under an hour and became briefly famous. After costs the club is {amount} up, and the local paper got a photograph it will use for years.
news.upSantaGrottoSubj: The grotto did not go to plan
news.upSantaGrotto: The idea was a Christmas grotto in the East Stand concourse. The execution involved a queue that stretched into the car park, a reindeer that was clearly a pony, and a Santa who had to be replaced at short notice for reasons the club will not be commenting on. Down {amount}, and the pony has been asked back.
news.upFilmCrewSubj: A film crew have taken over the ground
news.upFilmCrew: Something with a big budget and a lot of drizzle in it is being shot at {stadium} for a fortnight. The club is {amount} up, catering has never been better, and three academy lads have been paid to stand in the background looking disappointed, which they described afterwards as the easiest money of their lives.
news.upClubhouseSubj: The clubhouse has become the place to be
news.upClubhouse: Somebody put a proper coffee machine in, somebody else started a Thursday quiz, and the clubhouse at {stadium} has quietly turned into the busiest room for miles. Takings are up, the committee are delighted, and a local darts team has asked whether they can move in permanently. {amount} to the good.
news.campRoundSubj: Word from camp: {n} of yours were out there
news.campRound:
{tests} Tests, {n} of your players involved, and this is how the weekend went for them.

{blocks_ll}
news.campRoundV2Subj: Test weekend: how your {n} got on
news.campRoundV2:
The national coaches have sent their reports back: {n} of your players, {tests} Tests between them.

{blocks_ll}
news.campRoundV3Subj: On Test duty: the reports on your {n}
news.campRoundV3:
{tests} Tests this weekend with {n} of your players involved. Here is what the federation staff made of them.

{blocks_ll}
news.campBlockRest: ({n} more of yours in that one)
news.debtOpened: The club is overdrawn by {amount}. The board have asked for a plan to get it back, and they will keep asking.

debtPressure.one: {weeks} week overdrawn, now {amount} down. The boardroom is losing patience faster every month this goes on.
debtPressure.other: {weeks} weeks overdrawn, now {amount} down. The boardroom is losing patience faster every month this goes on.

debtCleared.one: The books balance again after {weeks} week in the red. The board say nothing, which is the compliment.
debtCleared.other: The books balance again after {weeks} weeks in the red. The board say nothing, which is the compliment.

news.cashRunway: About {amount} left in the bank, and {burn} more going out each week than coming in. At this rate the club is overdrawn within two months. The board would like the wage bill or the spending brought under control before then.
news.grudgeAbove: The table now reads {mine} and {theirs}, in that order. It has not read that way for a while, and the supporters' forum has noticed at once.
news.grudgeBelow: {rival} are above you in the table again - {theirs} to your {mine}. Their supporters have already made the graphic.
news.ledgerFirstAway: That's your first win at {ground}. It took {tries} {tries_k}. The travelling support enjoyed that one.
news.ledgerFirstDerby: Your first {derby} win, against {opp}. That one gets talked about in the clubhouse for years.
news.ledgerUnbeaten: Ten unbeaten in the league became {n}. Nobody in the building is saying the word out loud.
news.grKidRating: {kid} has found out what a video game thinks of that acceleration and has posted a screenshot with no caption, which on the internet counts as a declaration of war. The developers have replied with a shrug emoji. Three team-mates have replied agreeing with the game.
news.grKidRatingSubj: SOCIAL: {kidLast} discovers his own rating and takes it personally
news.staffSacked: {club} have parted company with {role_k} {name}. The club paid {cost} to end his contract; the role is vacant.
news.released: {club} have released {name} ({pos}, {age}) with immediate effect, paying off the remainder of his contract at a cost of {cost}. He is a free agent.

knockFlared.one: Playing through it has cost more than it saved: {name}'s injury flared up in the match, and the physio now has a lay-off of {n} week.
knockFlared.other: Playing through it has cost more than it saved: {name}'s injury flared up in the match, and the physio now has a lay-off of {n} weeks.

news.jokerSigned: {name} ({pos}, {age}) joins on a short-term deal to cover for {hurt}. The wage of {wage} sits outside the salary cap during the cover, and the deal ends when {hurt} is fit again or at the end of the season.
news.jokerEndsFit: {hurt} is fit again, so {name}'s short-term deal as a medical joker is over. {name} leaves with the club's thanks and is now a free agent.
news.jokerEndsGone: The player {name} was covering has left the club, so the medical-joker deal ends. {name} is now a free agent.
news.jokerEndsSeason: The season is over and so is {name}'s medical-joker deal. {name} is now a free agent and can be signed again on ordinary terms.
news.grounds1Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: shorts give way, lineout waits
news.grounds1: A {club} prop reached the front of a lineout on Saturday with his shorts around his knees, having lost a one-sided argument with a breakdown thirty seconds earlier. Unbothered, they called for the ball twice. The referee, less relaxed, stopped the game and sent them to the touchline to be reassembled. The broadcaster showed the sky for eleven seconds.
news.grounds1_w: A {club} prop reached the front of a lineout on Saturday with her shorts around her knees, having lost a one-sided argument with a breakdown thirty seconds earlier. Unbothered, they called for the ball twice. The referee, less relaxed, stopped the game and sent them to the touchline to be reassembled. The broadcaster showed the sky for eleven seconds.
news.grounds2Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: two home kits, no away kit, one long afternoon
news.grounds2: The kit van arrived at {other} carrying two full sets of {club} home shirts and no away shirts whatsoever. Since both clubs play in much the same colour, the visitors spent the first half in a borrowed set belonging to the host's third team, complete with a local plumber's name across the chest. Nobody could tell anybody apart, least of all the players.
news.grounds3Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: dog takes the ball, dog keeps the ball
news.grounds3: Play at {club} was held up for three minutes when a supporter's terrier got onto the pitch, took the match ball cleanly off a ruck and declined all offers to give it back. It was eventually traded a roll of strapping tape by the home fly-half, who later described the negotiation as the hardest of the season.
news.grounds4Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: the mud sends off the wrong man
news.grounds4: Conditions at {club} were so bad by the hour mark that the numbers had gone entirely, and the referee sent the wrong prop off for ten minutes over a repeated scrum offence. The right prop, standing beside him, said nothing at all. The review afterwards put it right on paper, which was of limited comfort to the ten minutes.
news.grounds5Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: a lifetime of socks down, finally noticed
news.grounds5: A senior {club} forward has played with socks around the ankles since the age of fifteen, on the grounds that it has always worked. A camera angle on Saturday made this the most discussed thing about the match, which finished 12-9. Asked about it four times since, the answer has been the same each time: they were fine.
news.grounds6Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: bus leaves, winger does not
news.grounds6: The {club} bus completed roughly forty minutes of the journey home from {other} before anyone established that a young winger was still at the service station, where he had gone in for a coffee and come out to an empty car park. He got a lift back with a family who had been at the match and who, by all accounts, had opinions about the second half.
news.grounds7Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: forty kicks, no rugby, one furious internet
news.grounds7: A three-minute passage of {club} and {other} kicking the ball to one another without interruption has been watched several million times this week by people expressing disappointment. It was raining sideways at the time and both sides thought it was going rather well. The clip has been titled "tennis" by everybody except the two coaches.
news.grounds8Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: announcer reads one score rather louder than the other
news.grounds8: The stadium announcer at {club} has been asked to consider his tone after Saturday's heavy home win, in which every home score was delivered at considerable volume and the visitors' single penalty was murmured like a man admitting to a broken window. The away club has written a letter. The home crowd has started a petition to keep him.
news.grounds9Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: pitch invader tackles nobody, ruins everything
news.grounds9: Somebody in a dressing gown got onto the pitch at {club} at the precise moment the home side had an overlap on the right, and stood in the way of it. They appeared to be as surprised as anybody. The move broke down, the scrum came back, and the club has spent the week talking about stewarding rather than the four tries.
news.grounds10Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: pub side challenges a professional squad, sells out
news.grounds10: A pub team near {club} challenged the professional squad to a charity crossbar contest during the international break and, to widespread astonishment, the professionals said yes. Four hundred people came. The pub team won on the last kick, and the money went to the local hospital, so nobody involved is admitting how seriously it was taken.
news.grounds11Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: the away kit that launched a thousand opinions
news.grounds11: {club} have unveiled an away shirt that the club describes as a bold reinterpretation of its heritage and that its supporters describe, at length and with imagination, as something else. It has sold out twice. The club has been careful not to say whether that proves the point or disproves it.
news.totySubj: TEAM OF THE YEAR: the fifteen are named
news.toty:
The governing body has published its Team of the Year, one player in each shirt, chosen on what the last twelve months actually looked like rather than on reputation.

{rows_ll}
news.totyMineSubj: The Team of the Year is worth money to us
news.totyMine: We have {n} in the Team of the Year: {names}. Replica shirts with those names are selling faster than we can print them, two promoters want an evening with them, and sponsors who ignored us in September are asking what an endorsement costs. Worth {money}, and none of it out of the playing budget.
news.friendlyBooked: {club} will come to {short} on {date}. No gate money worth counting. It's eighty minutes for the academy and the players who haven't had a game.
news.islesOfferSubj: An invitation from the four unions
news.islesOffer:
The four unions have written to you jointly. They want you to take the British & Irish Isles XV to {host} this summer: seven provincial games and a three-Test series.

There is no shortlist and no interview. They have chosen, and they are asking. Your assistant takes your national side while you are away.
news.srPredBeat: The pundits said {pred_o} and you finished {act_o}. They owe you an apology.
news.srPredExact: The pundits said {pred_o}, and {act_o} it was. Read like a book.
news.srPredMiss: The pundits said {pred_o} and you finished {act_o}. The phone-ins will be brutal.
news.jobOffered: {club} have made a formal offer. The desk, the squad and a transfer budget of {budget} are yours if you want them, and {stadium} would like an answer.
news.jobDeclined: {manager} has turned {club} down. The board thank him for his time and move to the next name on their list, which is how these things go.
news.jobWithdrawn: {club} waited as long as a board waits, heard nothing, and have appointed somebody else. The offer is off the table.
news.mentorLost_f: With {mentor} gone, {kid} is training alone again. The academy coach will keep an eye on her, but it isn't the same.

wantsTerms_f.one: {player}'s agent has been on the phone. Their client is playing out of her skin (avg {avg}) on {wage}/week, and the market pays well north of that. She has {n} year left, but the agent says her head will drop if this drags on, and other clubs will hear about it.
wantsTerms_f.other: {player}'s agent has been on the phone. Their client is playing out of her skin (avg {avg}) on {wage}/week, and the market pays well north of that. She has {n} years left, but the agent says her head will drop if this drags on, and other clubs will hear about it.

news.agentPublic_f: Two months without a word from the club, so the agent has gone to the papers: "{player} is one of the best-performing players in the league and the club knows our position." Rival clubs read the papers too.
news.becomesMentor_f: The coaches have seen it in the little things: the extras after training, the way she talks in the huddle. {player} is starting to carry herself like {mentor}.
news.aheadOfSchedule_f: Good news from the physios: {player} ({injury_k}) is ahead of her rehab targets and available again this week, earlier than expected.
news.wPeaceBrokered_f: The manager got them in a room and shut the door. Both women came out and trained. Nobody is pretending they are friends, but the squad can get on with its week.
news.wBoot1_f: {player} has signed a personal sponsorship with a boot manufacturer. Her locker now contains fourteen boxes of boots and one very smug grin.
news.wAdvert1_f: {player} spent her day off filming an advert for a regional car dealership. Team-mates have already got hold of the script. Expect dramatic readings in the team room.
news.wAdvert2_f: {player} is the new face of a local bathroom showroom. The billboard goes up next month. The dressing room has already ordered a framed print for her locker.
news.wChef1_f: The performance department has brought in {chef_k} for the rest of the season. The senior pros are sceptical. The youngsters are all-in. Someone has already broken the new equipment.
news.wRumour1_f: {buyerName} have had scouts at {ownerPoss} last three matches. The woman they're watching is {player}.
news.wRumour2_f: Agents claim {buyer} are readying a {fee} bid for {player}. {owner} insist she is going nowhere.
news.wAgent2_f: Six months left on {player}'s deal, and her agent has started picking up on the first ring.
news.wAgent3_f: The contract clock is ticking on {player}, and this week her agent was photographed at lunch with two directors of rugby who were not yours. Draw your own conclusions. Everyone else has.
news.grForumExit_f: One unsourced post claiming {star} has "told friends she wants out" has produced four hundred replies, two spin-off threads and a poll. There is no agent, no journalist and no evidence. Page nine is arguing about the stadium car park. One moderator: "Every year. Same thread. Same fella posting it."
news.grSocialClip_f: Two million views and counting for a clip of {star} doing something that should not be physically available to a woman that size. The comments are split between awe and accusations of a smaller pitch. {shortPoss} media team have posted it, deleted it, and posted it again with worse music.
news.grAiGraphic_f: The pre-match player card rendered {star} with an extra finger, a surname spelled two different ways in the same graphic, and a career-tries figure that would make her the leading scorer in the sport's history. The broadcaster has apologised. The screenshot is already a profile picture.
news.grSchoolVisit_f: A local primary asked the {short} academy whether anyone could hand out a reading prize. {kid} arrived early, stayed two hours and signed everything put in front of her including the lectern and one teacher's laptop lid. The video has more views than the club's last three tries combined.
news.grPropGymSubj_f: SOCIAL: {propLast} lifts something she should not have lifted
news.grDrone_f: Somebody flew a drone over a closed session hoping for the team sheet and captured forty minutes of a squad doing a passing drill in complete silence, plus one woman tying a lace for nine of them. The footage has been posted anyway. It has done numbers.
news.grQuiz_f: The media team filmed a light-hearted club history quiz and released it without watching it back. Nobody named the ground's record attendance, one woman guessed the club was founded in 1998, and the captain named a competition that has never existed. It is the club's most watched video of the season.
news.chTale1_f: {prop} shot the round of her life at the team golf day and has already had the scorecard laminated. It is now blu-tacked inside her locker at eye level. The backs have demanded a recount; the referee (the kit man) says the result stands.
news.chTale5_f: At a community visit this week the fastest woman at the club was beaten over 40 metres by a twelve-year-old wearing school shoes. {wing} maintains the start was jumped and has formally requested a rematch "on a proper track, with blocks". The twelve-year-old's PE teacher is considering terms.
news.wWin5_f: A girl in the family stand has started bringing a homemade cardboard trophy. Three straight wins. Her dad keeps apologising to the row behind and nobody minds.
news.wLoseOn3_f: The slump goes on and the woman with the flask in row F has started bringing a book. She has renewed every year since 1987. She will renew again. She would just like a reason.
news.wKid3_f: The stopwatch brigade were out in force again for {clubPoss} {pos} {player}. She is {age}. The women in the stand with clipboards were not there for the tea.
news.wMerc1_f: , and her agent is already dialling
news.wMerc2_f: , and her agent says it loudest
news.wGrumble1_f: Sources say {player} ({pos}, rated among your best) trained away from the main group on Monday. Her camp's message: "She didn't come here to hold tackle bags." The mood is souring{merc1_k}.
news.wGrumble3_f: The cameras caught {player} watching the warm-up from the bench again, jaw set. A {pos} of her standing does not stay quiet forever{merc3_k}. The dressing room is watching how you handle it.
news.friendly_f: {club} have agreed to a run-out at your place: minutes for the fringe women and a hit-out for anyone coming back from injury.
news.ddRoundupFlop_f:
The window is shut. {n} deals crossed the line on the final day{big_k}:
{rows_ll}
23:40 - COLLAPSED: {flop}'s move fell apart at the medical. She stays at {flopClub}, for now.
Back to rugby.
news.keptPlans_f: You told {player} she was in your plans, and the team sheets backed it up. She knocked on your door after training: "You didn't have to promise me anything, and you kept it anyway. Thanks, coach." The rest of the dressing room noticed too.
news.keptMinutes_f: {player} got the minutes you promised her. She found you in the corridor after the session: "You said I'd get my chance and you kept your word. I won't forget that, coach." The academy coach is pleased too: "That's how you bring one through."
news.keptDeal_f: {player} has her new deal, as you said she would. The senior pros noticed.
news.brokePlans_f: You told {player} she was in your plans {n} weeks ago. She has barely seen the pitch since. The conversation has leaked to the squad, and her agent is already briefing that "the manager's word means nothing at this club."
news.brokeMinutes_f: {player} was promised minutes and got none. She trained with headphones in all week, and the academy coach has stopped defending you in the canteen.
news.brokeDeal_f: {player} is still waiting for the deal you as good as promised her. She held off other offers on your word and now feels strung along. The older heads in the squad are watching how this ends.

wcHomeA_f.one: {nationCap_k} are champions of the world, and {names} was in the squad that did it. The shirt is going in a frame. She comes back to training a world champion.
wcHomeA_f.other: {nationCap_k} are champions of the world, and {names} were in the squad that did it. The shirts are going in frames. They come back to training as world champions.

wcHomeB_f.one: When the confetti came down after the World Championship final, {names} of {nationThe_k} was standing under it. Your player. World champion.
wcHomeB_f.other: When the confetti came down after the World Championship final, {names} of {nationThe_k} were standing under it. Your players. World champions.

news.guardA_f: A guard of honour at training this week: {player} made her {n_o} senior appearance at the weekend. {tail_k}
news.guardB_f: They lined the tunnel for her on Monday morning: {n} senior appearances for {player}, and she shrugged it off like a woman who intends to double it. {tail_k}
news.guardC_f: {player} reached {n} senior appearances at the weekend. The kit man found the old shirts, somebody found the old photographs, and the youngsters learned who she used to be. {tail_k}
news.guardTail300_f: They will name something after her one day.
news.bigOneStarB_f: and {bStar} in the form of her life
news.adsB_f: The broadcaster's trailer dropped this morning: thunder, mud, your crest filling the screen{venue_k}. The squad played it in the team room eleven times. The kit man has ironed everything twice.
news.retires_f: {player} ({age}) knocks on your door before the press get hold of it: she is retiring at the end of the season. No fuss. She wanted you to hear it from her first. The chief scout is not keen on the {pos} market this year.
news.retiresSucc_f: {player} ({age}) knocks on your door before the press get hold of it: she is retiring at the end of the season. No fuss. She wanted you to hear it from her first. The chief scout reckons the {pos} shirt is covered: {succ}.
news.loanLevel_f: playing every week and doing her job. Their coaches like her, but they think this is her level.
news.loanStar_f: the first name on their team sheet. Their coach says she is running games at that level. Expect a different player back in the summer.
news.loanSteady_f: getting the minutes she went for. Steady rather than spectacular, but every week down there is a week she was not carrying tackle bags here.
news.momTailOurs_f: A good week for the club, and a lift for the woman herself.
news.potyYours_f: She's yours. The biggest individual prize in the game, and the market will be circling her by tomorrow.
news.potyPodium_f: One of yours made the podium. The scouts noticed; so did her agent.
news.lastYearOne_f: Development deals run out at 21, and this season is the last one for {men_l}. Promote her to a professional contract before next summer, or the deal expires and she walks for nothing.
news.releasedOne_f: No professional terms were offered, so at 21 the academy road ends: {men_l} leaves as a free agent. The academy coach clears her locker and starts again with the next intake.
news.hofOne_f: {men_l} retires with numbers nobody can argue with. {mine_k} Her plaque goes up with the rest of the greats.
news.hofYoursOne_f: She finished her career as one of yours, and the club will be claiming her for years.
news.academyBuzz_f: {heir}, a {age}-year-old {pos}, has joined the academy, and the coaches reckon she has everything {player} had at that age.
news.shirtUp_f: The farewell tour is over. {player} finishes with {apps} appearances for the club, and this morning her shirt went up over the tunnel where every young player will walk under it.
news.intakeDayB_f: A strong group. At least one of these girls should be a first-team regular.
news.totsHere_f: She collects the award at the end-of-season dinner to the loudest cheer of the night.
news.totsGone_f: She is not at the club to collect it, which makes the ovation longer, not shorter.
news.loanBack_f: A season of regular rugby has done {player} the world of good. She's come back sharper.
news.loanEnds_f: {player}'s loan is up and she heads back to her parent club. Proper minutes here, and it shows.
news.lastDanceSubj_f: The last dance: {player} announces her farewell season
news.lastDance_f: {player} ({age}, {pos}) has told the squad this season will be her last. {apps} appearances in the shirt, and one year left to add to them. Her testimonial is the pre-season match at {stadium} in week {week}, and the ground will want to see her in it.
news.preVoid_f: {player} has been sold before her deal expired, and the move voids the pre-contract she signed with you. Your summer signing is off. The lawyers say there is nothing to be done.
news.preAgreed_f: {player} ({pos}, {age}) has signed a pre-contract with {club}. She sees the season out at {seller}, then joins on a free at terms of {wage}/week. {tail_k}
news.gazumped_f: You left her renewal on the desk too long. {player} has agreed a pre-contract with {to} and will walk for nothing when the season ends. The deal is binding. No fee, and no way back.
news.loanIn_f: {player} ({age}, {pos}) joins on loan {len_k}. {parent} cover {share}% of her wage, and they'll expect her to play.
news.loanOut_f: {player} joins {club} for the rest of the season. First-team rugby every week should bring her on, and she'll be back next summer.
news.recalledFull_f: {player} ({pos}, {age}) is back, match-fit from weekly rugby and better for the months away. The feeder club were sorry to see her go.
news.huntBid_f:
So it was not paper talk. {club} have made {player} a formal offer of {fee}, comfortably above her valuation, and they have been building to this since the autumn.

You have known it was coming for months. Now you answer it.

transferRequest_f.one: She was told where she stood ({status_k}), and the team sheets say {n} appearance from {played} matches. This morning a formal transfer request landed on your desk. Minutes might still talk her round. If not, every agent in the league will know she's gettable.
transferRequest_f.other: She was told where she stood ({status_k}), and the team sheets say {n} appearances from {played} matches. This morning a formal transfer request landed on your desk. Minutes might still talk her round. If not, every agent in the league will know she's gettable.

ledgerSubj_f.one: Game time: {n} player is not getting what she was told
ledgerSubj_f.other: Game time: {n} players are not getting what they were told

ledgerMoreSubj_f.one: Game time: {n} player is not getting what she was told
ledgerMoreSubj_f.other: Game time: {n} players are not getting what they were told

news.ledgerMan_f: {name} ({status_k}): {actual} of the {expected} games she was promised.
news.ledgerWatch_f: {worst} is the one to watch. Another month of this and her agent will be on the phone.
news.mentGraduates_f: The pairing has run its course. {why_k} {senior} shook her hand after training and the mentoring slot is free for the next one.
news.mentAdopted_f: She carries herself like {senior} now, which was the whole point.
news.mentCeiling_f: The coaches agree there is nothing left on the syllabus. She is the player she was going to be.
news.mentAged_f: At {age} she is a senior pro in her own right, and senior pros do not get lifts to the ground.
news.mentThriving_f: {fit_k}. {reason_k} The academy coach says {kid} has started doing the unglamorous jobs without being asked. She's coming on quicker for it.
news.mentFailing_f: {fit_k}. {reason_k} {kid} is getting very little out of it. Nothing has gone wrong between them. It just isn't working.

specialist_f.one: A second opinion on {player}'s {injury_k}, and a different rehab plan. She should be back {n} week earlier than expected.
specialist_f.other: A second opinion on {player}'s {injury_k}, and a different rehab plan. She should be back {n} weeks earlier than expected.

news.slListed_f: has been transfer-listed by {short}. She'll come cheap, and she won't be on the list long.
news.slExpiring_f: is out of contract this summer and {short} haven't tied her down. She could come on a free.
news.slForm_f: is in the form of her life ({form}). Her price is climbing by the week.
news.capFine_f: {club} finished the season {over}/wk over the {cap}/wk salary cap. The league fine the club {fine} and put it on notice: breach it again next season and the punishment is a transfer embargo. Two women can be named marquee and taken out of the calculation, and academy players never counted.
news.adminOther_f: {club} have gone into administration after a season they could not pay for. The league will dock them {n} points, and two senior women have already been released as the administrators cut the wage bill.

postcard_f.one:
{weeksIn} weeks into the brief. "{verdict_k} I'll keep looking. About {n} week till I write it all up."

She is properly scouted now: a true reading, not a range.
postcard_f.other:
{weeksIn} weeks into the brief. "{verdict_k} I'll keep looking. About {n} weeks till I write it all up."

She is properly scouted now: a true reading, not a range.

news.postcardKeen_f: Seen {player} twice now and I'd put my name to her. {age}, {pos_k} {at_k}, and she does the things you can't teach.
news.postcardMaybe_f: {player} is worth a mention. {age}, {pos_k} {at_k}. Not the answer on her own, but I wouldn't rule her out.
news.scoutReport_f: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them he would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every name on it is now fully scouted.
news.noteA1_f: Ready now. She'd walk into your XV.
news.noteA2_f: Best in her position I've seen all trip.
news.noteB2_f: A season of proper coaching and she's a starter.
news.noteD2_f: I've seen better, but someone will pay for her.
news.aLostLine0_f: Nobody's fussed about the score. The minutes were the point, and the young players got plenty.
news.aLostLine5_f: The coach reckons they were beaten by bigger women, and that bigger women are a matter of time.
news.aTitleMine_f: The A side finish top of the {comp}: {w} wins from {p}, {pf} points scored. Nobody hangs a flag for it. The coaches know what it means, though: some of these players will be in your matchday 23 within three years.
news.testimonialDay_f: {stadium} was full for {player}'s testimonial{scored_k}. She insisted the gate ({gate}) goes to the club. One more season in the shirt to come.
news.oldBoyWeWonSubj_f: Old girl {player} crosses against her former club
news.oldBoyWeLostSubj_f: Old girl {player} crosses against her former club
news.oldBoyWeLost_f: Of course it was her. {player} - {apps} appearances in your colours before she left - crossed against her old club and the ground knew it was coming.
news.capMilestone_f: {player} brought up her {n_o} cap for {nationThe_k} this week. Special jersey, and a guard of honour when she got back to training.

suspended_f.one: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} match following her red card. She will be unavailable until the ban is served.
suspended_f.other: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} matches following her red card. She will be unavailable until the ban is served.

news.debutAcademySubj_f: A debut to tell her grandkids about: {player}
news.debutAcademy_f: {player} ({age}, {pos}) came through the academy and made her first-team debut today.{scored_k}{motm_k} The press box gave her {rating}. The supporters will have a song for her by Tuesday.
news.debutSigning_f: First competitive appearance for {player} ({pos}) since signing, and she made it count.{scored_k}{motm_k} Rated {rating} by the press box.
news.debutMotm_f: The sponsors gave her the match award before she had learned everyone's names.
news.mentorSpread_f: {name} has two kids under her wing and she mentioned it after training. Politely, but she mentioned it. The extras are shared now, so each girl is learning at about three-quarter speed.
news.trPushA_f: Knocking on the door: {name} is training like a woman who wants the shirt.
news.appealFreeToPlay_f: She is free to play this weekend.
news.heal_f: The specialist retreat has done its job: {n} of the squad came back with a clean bill of health. Every injury cleared. Match sharpness still has to come back the old way, on a Saturday.
news.dressingDown_f: Word has leaked that {player} was hauled in front of the coach over her recent form - and didn't take it well. Team-mates say she trained on her own on Tuesday.
news.fanSoldStar_f: {player} has gone to {to} and {club}'s support are not taking it well: the forums say this is a club selling its best and buying nobody, and one supporter has changed her profile picture to a black square. Fan mood down {n}.
news.fanSignedStar_f: {player} is a {club} player. The announcement video has been watched more times than the club has ever sold tickets, the club shop has sold out of the letters in her name, and a local bakery is doing a limited-edition pastry nobody can describe. Fan mood is up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanSignedIconSubj_f: THEY'VE ONLY GONE AND SIGNED HER: {player}
news.fanSignedIcon_f: There were people on the streets. Actual people, on a Tuesday. {player} has signed for {club} and {city} has lost all proportion: two babies named after the manager, a woman tattooed somewhere she will regret, the club song eleven times before lunch. Fan mood up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanRivalNamed_f: In the dressing room the mood is more complicated: {rival} has just watched her shirt get a great deal harder to keep.
news.fanRivalNone_f: Nobody in the squad plays where she plays, which is exactly why she was signed.
news.upFilmCrew_f: Something with a big budget and a lot of drizzle in it is being shot at {stadium} for a fortnight. The club is {amount} up, catering has never been better, and three academy kids have been paid to stand in the background looking disappointed, which they described afterwards as the easiest money of their lives.
news.grKidRatingSubj_f: SOCIAL: {kidLast} discovers her own rating and takes it personally
news.released_f: {club} have released {name} ({pos}, {age}) with immediate effect, paying off the remainder of her contract at a cost of {cost}. She is a free agent.
news.grounds4Subj_f: AROUND THE GROUNDS: the mud sends off the wrong woman
news.grounds6_f: The {club} bus completed roughly forty minutes of the journey home from {other} before anyone established that a young winger was still at the service station, where she had gone in for a coffee and come out to an empty car park. She got a lift back with a family who had been at the match and who, by all accounts, had opinions about the second half.
news.friendlyBooked_f: {club} will come to {short} on {date}. No gate money worth counting. It's eighty minutes for the academy and the women who haven't had a game.
news.grPunditGem_f: This week's big read calls {kid}, {kidAge}, "the most natural {kidPos} of her generation" and notes that half the league already knows. {short} supporters have spent the day asking the columnist, mostly politely, to delete it. He has replied to eleven of them individually.
news.fanSceptic1_w: Never heard of her. Hope the board know something we don't.
news.fanSceptic3_w: I'll judge her in May, not August.
news.fanHopeful2_w: Give her two seasons and a bit of money and see what happens.
news.fanHopeful3_w: She's said the right things. Now let's see her pick a team.
news.fanPatient1_w: Steady on. New woman, new voice, same old fixture list.
news.fanPatient2_w: The squad is the squad. She can only work with what's in the building.
news.fanPatient3_w: First home game will tell us plenty about how she wants to play.
news.intakeGradeA_w: Her verdict: "There is a special one in this group. I would stake my job on it."
news.intakeGradeB_w: Her verdict: "A strong year. One or two of these will play first-team rugby."
news.intakeGradeC_w: Her verdict: "Honest, coachable kids. Do not expect fireworks."
news.intakeGradeD_w: Her verdict: "A lean year. We will need to buy young instead."
news.intakeGradeE_w: Her verdict: "Between us? Start scouting elsewhere."
news.loanOne_w:
The academy manager files her loan report:
{rows_ll}
news.loanMany_w:
The academy manager files her loan report:
{rows_ll}
news.assHandWin_w: She hands the week back with a win and an insufferable grin.
news.assHandLoss_w: She hands the week back with an apology and a full debrief already on your desk.
news.assHandDraw_w: She hands the week back all square.

bossNotLookingDown_w.one: {boss} has been enjoying herself. "Somebody asked whether I keep an eye on {me}. I keep an eye on the table, and the table says what it says." That's a {n}-point gap, and she made sure everyone heard about it.
bossNotLookingDown_w.other: {boss} has been enjoying herself. "Somebody asked whether I keep an eye on {me}. I keep an eye on the table, and the table says what it says." That's a {n}-point gap, and she made sure everyone heard about it.

news.bossSize2_w: Asked to name the side she least wants to draw, {boss} went somewhere else entirely. "I would not give anybody that headline." Pressed on {meShort} specifically, she said they were "hard to play against on their day", which is a sentence with a trapdoor in it.
news.bossSize3_w: {boss} says she has stopped watching the table. "It is August somewhere in my head. I will look in April." She then named {mePoss} last three results from memory, in order, which rather gave the game away.
news.bossSize4_w: A short one from {boss} this morning. "{meShort}? Good club, good crowd, good coach." Three compliments and not one word about their rugby. She knows exactly what she is doing.
news.bossTight_w: {club}'s {boss} was asked about you this morning and did not bother pretending. "{who_k}, with everything still to play for. I have watched every game they have played this year. They are good. We are better in the tight five, and I think that is what decides it." {gap_k}, and she has just made it personal.
news.rivalAboveYou_w: {his} against {mine}. {boss} was right, or the table says she was, and in this job that is the same thing. She will not have forgotten a word of it.
news.staffHired_w: {club} have their woman: {name}, {age}, a {badge_k}-badged {role_k}. {fee} compensation, {wage} a week.{out_k}{chem_k}
news.staffClick_w: The staff room approves: she and {other} click - {note_k}.
news.staffClash_w: One cloud on the horizon: she and {other} see the game very differently - {note_k}.
news.badgePass_w: {name} came through a day of written papers and an assessed session in front of examiners who have seen it all. The club has a better {role_k} for it, and her pay goes up to {wage} a week.
news.badgeFail_w: The examiners wanted more from {name} on the assessed session. She took it well, asked for the feedback in writing and pinned it above her desk. The {fee} is spent either way, and the next intake will not take her for a month.
news.badgePassAuto_w: {name} is now {badge_k}-badged, and a better {role_k} than the club had last month. There's a certificate for the office wall and her pay goes up to {wage} a week.
news.badgeFailAuto_w: Not this time. {name} came up short on the assessed session, asked for the feedback in writing and pinned it above her desk. She can sit it again in four weeks.
news.briefSent_w: {fee} of expenses, a hire car and a brief: {brief_k} {where_k}. {scout} ({badge_k} badge) files her report in {n} weeks. The longer she's out, the more rugby she sees.
news.scoutReport_w: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them she would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every name on it is now fully scouted.
news.scoutReport_fw: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them she would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every name on it is now fully scouted.
news.aWonLine1_w: She was happier with the last twenty minutes than with the scoreline.
news.aWonLine5_w: She signed off with one line: "That is the standard now."
news.aLostLine2_w: She wants you to know which three kept going at 20 down, because those are the three who will make it.
news.aLostLine4_w: "Nobody hid." That was her whole report.
news.staffSacked_w: {club} have parted company with {role_k} {name}. The club paid {cost} to end her contract; the role is vacant.
news.requestGrantedSubj: {player} is free to find a club
news.requestGranted: The request is granted and the name goes on the list. {club} will listen to offers, and every agent in the league already knows it.
news.requestRefused: The request is refused. There is a contract, {club} intend to hold it, and the only way out of this now is through the team sheet.
news.chalCircus: Gloucester's run is over and the roadshow has left town. Sarries are champions of England, and your record against them says it was no accident.
news.chalEaling: Two titles at Trailfinders. The club people said had bought its way in has now won it on the grass. Twice.
news.chalLicence: Sale finish in the play-off places. Nobody is asking about the licence any more.
news.chalGrudge: Lichfield are champions of the Championship. Passed over when the top flight chose its members, and impossible to ignore now.
news.deputationOne: A group of senior players come into the office and shut the door. Polite, but blunt: the {a} situation has been left to drift, and they want to know who is in charge. Deal with it in the {room_k} and win on Saturday, and that should be the end of it.
news.deputationNamedOne: {player} comes into the office and shuts the door. Polite, but blunt: the squad have watched the {a} situation drift and want to know who's in charge. Sort it out in the {room_k}, win on Saturday, and you won't see this again.
news.deputationOneSubj: The senior players ask for a meeting
news.expOpened: The hoardings are down and the turnstiles are open: {stadium} now holds {cap}, {seats} of them new. The season-ticket waiting list is finally moving.

trainInjury_w.one: {player} came off the training paddock holding it: {injury_k}. The physio wants a week on it, so she misses the next one.
trainInjury_w.other: {player} came off the training paddock holding it: {injury_k}. The physio has her down for about {n} weeks, so she is out of your reckoning until then.

trainInjury.one: {player} came off the training paddock holding it: {injury_k}. The physio wants a week on it, so he misses the next one.
trainInjury.other: {player} came off the training paddock holding it: {injury_k}. The physio has him down for about {n} weeks, so he is out of your reckoning until then.

news.upSeatsSubj: Twelve hundred seats have gone the colour of weak tea
news.upSeats: Nobody notices a plastic seat until it is the wrong colour, and fifteen summers of sun have taken whole blocks at {stadium} from club red to something closer to salmon. Worse, they have perished with it: three snapped under perfectly ordinary supporters on Saturday. Replacing the affected blocks comes to {amount}.
news.upToiletsSubj: The gents at the Popular End, again
news.upToilets: The half-time queue at {stadium} now forms outside, in the rain, because two thirds of the gents at the Popular End are out of order and one of them has been out of order since a cup tie nobody can date. The plumber's verdict was short and the invoice is not: {amount} for new cisterns, new pipework and a drainage run that he described as "period".
news.upCellarSubj: The cellar cooling packed in on a Friday
news.upCellar: The cooling in the {stadium} cellar failed at some point on Friday night and was discovered on Saturday morning by a steward who described the smell as "warm". Eleven kegs written off, a bar that ran on bottles all afternoon, and a compressor that the engineer says was old when he started. Between the stock and the plant it comes to {amount}.
news.upPowerSubj: The electricity bill has arrived and it is wrong. It is not wrong.
news.upPower: Somebody at {stadium} queried the quarterly electricity bill on the reasonable grounds it could not be right, and the supplier has been through it twice. It is right. Floodlights on a broadcast standard, concourse lighting running around the clock since a timer failed in the autumn, and refrigeration nobody has switched off since the summer. {amount}, payable now.
news.upSurvey: The annual condition survey on {stadium} is in and it is the usual list, which is the problem: barriers, handrails, a run of guttering, the paint on the turnstile block and a fire door that no longer closes on its own. None of it is dramatic and all of it has to be done. {amount}.
news.upConferenceSubj: The conference business had a quarter
news.upConference: Nobody puts a banqueting suite in a rugby ground for the rugby. {stadium} has spent the quarter hosting two trade fairs, a wedding fair, an insurance company's away day and a regional final of something involving spreadsheets. {amount} on the books, and the events manager would like it noted that she has been saying this for years.
news.upToursSubj: Stadium tours are quietly making money
news.upTours: The tour of {stadium} - dressing room, tunnel, a go on the PA, a photograph with the trophy cabinet - has been running all season on a part-timer and a volunteer, and the school bookings have gone through the roof. {amount}, most of it in the shop on the way out, which the retail manager insists was the whole idea.
news.upNamingSubj: The sponsor wants the stand, not the shirt
news.upNaming: A sponsor has been round {stadium} with a tape measure and come back with an offer for the North Stand: their name on it, their colours in the concourse, and a hospitality package that the commercial department has already sold twice over. {amount}, up front. The supporters' trust has views about the name and has been invited to share them at the next forum.
news.boardNo_time: The chairman heard you out and gave you nothing. "We back managers who are winning. Win, and you will find us very supportive." The door is shut for a couple of months.
news.boardNo_funds: The finance director did most of the talking, and most of it was about the current account. There is no more money this season.
news.boardNo_facilities: The board is not minded to pour concrete on this season's evidence. Build a case on the pitch first.
news.boardNo_facilitiesSubj: Board says no: a facilities upgrade
news.boardNo_staff: The backroom stays the size it is. "Get more out of the ones you have" is a sentence every manager hears eventually.
news.boardNo_staffSubj: Board says no: a bigger backroom
news.boardYes_time: The chairman has come out for you publicly, in print, with his name on it. That buys you until the new year, whatever the table says. Don't expect him to do it twice.
news.boardYes_funds: The board has found money it did not have last week, which is what winning does to a balance sheet. It is in the transfer budget now.
news.boardYes_facilities: The board will fund the next build itself. Go to Club Infrastructure and ask for it; the bill is theirs, not yours.
news.boardYes_facilitiesSubj: The board will pay for the next build
news.boardYes_staff: The board has ring-fenced money for the backroom. It is not in the transfer budget and it cannot be moved there: it pays for coaches, for the courses that badge them, and for the eight weeks it takes to move one on.
news.bondRift: The dressing room has noticed that {a} and {b} have stopped talking to each other. {cause_k} Training has been frosty and the rest of the squad are starting to pick sides.
news.bondMateGone: {player} and {mate} were close, and it shows now that {mate} has gone. Fewer words at training, first out of the door afterwards. A word in the office would not go amiss.
news.bondCliqueSubj: A clique forms in the dressing room
news.bondClique: In the canteen there is now a table for {group_k}, and nobody else sits at it. The group feel the team sheet has favourites and they are not among them: {names_l} and the rest. Their tally of starts this season: {n}.
news.bondCliqueEnds: The table for {group_k} has broken up. The team sheets have been kinder to them lately, and the dressing room is one room again.
news.windowOpenSummerSubj: The summer transfer window is open
news.windowOpenSummer: The summer transfer window is now open. It shuts on {date}.
news.windowOpenJanuarySubj: The January transfer window is open
news.windowOpenJanuary: The January transfer window is now open. It shuts on {date}.
news.windowLeft3: The transfer window shuts on {date}. Three days remain for permanent signings and sales.
news.windowLeft2: The transfer window shuts on {date}. Two days remain for permanent signings and sales.
news.windowLeft1: The transfer window shuts at the end of {date}. Any permanent deal not done by then waits until it reopens.
news.windowShutJanuarySubj: The transfer window is now closed
news.windowShutJanuary: The transfer window is now closed. Permanent transfers resume when the January window opens on {date}.
news.windowShutSummerSubj: The transfer window is now closed
news.windowShutSummer: The transfer window is now closed. Permanent transfers resume when the summer window opens on {date}.

comm.oppCoachNamed: {coach} has done his homework: {team} are set up to stop {pattern_k}. Change the picture, or play through it.
comm.oppCoach: The opposition coach has done his homework: {team} are set up to stop {pattern_k}. Change the picture, or play through it.
comm.oppRematch: {team} haven't forgotten the last meeting. They've changed the plan for it.
comm.koFinalDayGate: The final, at {venue}. {att} inside and the noise is rolling round {city}. Kick-off!
comm.koFinalDay: The final, at {venue}. A full house and the noise is rolling round {city}. Kick-off!
comm.koDerbyGate: {derby}! {att} packed in and making an almighty noise. Kick-off!
comm.koDerby: {derby}! The crowd is making an almighty noise. Kick-off!
comm.koGrudge: There's history here: {reason_k}. Nobody's forgotten. Kick-off!
comm.koWind: A swirling wind, and the kickers won't enjoy it.
comm.koSnow: Snow in the air. Proper old-fashioned rugby weather, this.
comm.uncontested: The referee orders UNCONTESTED SCRUMS: {team} can't cover all three front-row positions. No shove and no scrum penalties from here.
comm.crowdBouncing: The place is bouncing. Full voice from the first whistle.
comm.crowdFlat: Flat in here. Edgy. The crowd want something to shout about.
comm.testimonial: {player}'s testimonial. He leads them out with his kids, and the whole ground is on its feet. Then the whistle goes and it's a game of rugby again.
comm.oldBoy: A familiar face out there: {player} lines up against {oldClub}, where he made {n} appearances. {tail_k}
comm.oldBoyKnowsThem: He knows this opposition inside out.
comm.oldBoyPolite: A polite reception from the home crowd - for now.
comm.milestoneApps: Career appearance number {n} for {player} today. Warm applause as he comes out of the tunnel.
comm.try1: TRY! {player} crashes over from close range!
comm.try2: TRY! {player} in at the corner. Lovely finish.
comm.try4: TRY! {player} powers over off the back of the maul!
comm.try5: TRY! {player} steps inside and dives over!
comm.try6: TRY! Right through the hands, and {player} finishes it off!
comm.try7: TRY! Quick tap by {player} catches the defence napping!
comm.try8: TRY! Grubber in behind, and {player} wins the race to it!
comm.try9: TRY! {player} arcs outside his man and won't be caught!
comm.try10: TRY! {player} picks from the base and burrows over!
comm.try11: TRY! What a fend from {player}! Strolls in.
comm.try12: TRY! {player} takes the offload one-handed and finishes!
comm.try13: TRY! {player} picks it off fifty metres out and is gone!
comm.try15: TRY! Pick-and-go, pick-and-go, and {player} forces it down!
comm.try16: TRY! {player} hits a lovely line off the shoulder and goes in untouched!
comm.try17: TRY! Wraparound, and {player} is straight through!
comm.try18: TRY! {player} bounces off three of them, and in he goes!
comm.try19: TRY! {player} shows and goes. Nobody within five metres of him!
comm.try20: TRY! Eight phases, then {player} down the short side!
comm.try21: TRY! {player} straightens, sits the last man down and strolls over!
comm.try22: TRY! In comes the blindside wing, and it's {player} who goes over!
comm.try23: TRY! {player} takes it flat and hits the line at full pace. No stopping that!
comm.try24: TRY! Turnover ball, three passes, and {player} is gone!
comm.try25: TRY! {player} reaches out one-handed through the tackle. The TMO has a look... and it's given!
comm.try26: TRY! No-look pass, and {player} is in at the flag! Cheeky.
comm.tryWet1: TRY! {player} follows a slithering kick through and wins the race!
comm.tryWet2: TRY! The greasy ball squirts loose and {player} pounces!
comm.tryWet3: TRY! {player} aquaplanes over in the corner! Nobody's minding the weather now.
comm.tryWet4: TRY! {player} slides in through the standing water. Didn't need to be pretty.
comm.tryWet5: TRY! The maul goes over in the mud and {player} comes up with the ball!
comm.tryDerby1: TRY! {player} scores and cups an ear to the away end. They didn't like that!
comm.tryDerby2: TRY! {player} settles a hundred pub arguments with that one!
comm.tryDerby3: TRY! {player} through a wall of bodies! Listen to this place!
comm.tryDerby4: TRY! {player} scores in front of the travelling fans and just stands there, arms wide!
comm.tryDerby5: TRY! {player} scores in the derby, and there'll be no living with this lot for a week!
comm.pen2: {player} makes no mistake from the tee.
comm.pen4: {player} from distance. Right down the middle.
comm.pen5: {player} takes his time... and drills it.
comm.pen6: From 45 metres, and {player} splits the posts.
comm.pen7: {player} scrapes it over off the left post. They all count.
comm.pen8: Ice in the veins: {player} silences the whistlers.
comm.penTouchOwnHalf: Out of range in their own half, so {team} kick to touch for the lineout.
comm.pen9: {player} thumps it over from just inside their half. What a boot.
comm.pen10: A horrible angle, and {player} makes it look like a warm-up.
comm.pen11: {player} wipes the mud off the ball, wipes the rain off his face, and nails it.
comm.con4: {player} strokes the conversion straight through the middle.
comm.con7: {player} barely looks at it. Over. Next job.
comm.con8: From right on the touchline, {player} draws it inside the far post. Beautiful kick.
comm.flavGrass1: {player} wins a scrappy one at the back of a collapsing maul - proper National 1 rugby, this.
comm.flavGrass2: A dog has briefly joined the {team} defensive line. Play carries on regardless.
comm.flavGrass3: {player} slips in the mud where the winter pitch never quite recovers. The crowd, all four hundred of them, enjoy that.
comm.flavGrass4: Huge cheer from the clubhouse balcony as {player} flattens his man. Someone rings the bell.
comm.flavGrass5: {team} work it through nine phases - patient stuff for this level, and the tea hut has gone quiet.
