comm.off_offsideLine1: Penalty. {player} offside, up out of the line too early.
comm.off_offsideLine2: Offside against {team}. A step too keen with the line speed.
comm.off_offsideRuck1: Penalty. {player} offside at the ruck, in front of the back foot.
comm.off_offsideRuck2: {team} caught offside at the breakdown, loitering on the wrong side.
comm.off_sideEntry1: Penalty: {player} in from the side at the ruck.
comm.off_sideEntry2: {team} penalised for coming in at the side. The referee has been watching for it.
comm.off_handsRuck1: Penalty: {player} with hands in the ruck after it had formed.
comm.off_handsRuck2: Hands in the ruck from {team}. The jackal stayed on a second too long.
comm.off_offFeet1: Penalty: {player} off the feet at the breakdown.
comm.off_offFeet2: {team} penalised for not supporting their own weight at the ruck.
comm.off_notRelease1: Penalty: {player} did not release the tackled player.
comm.off_notRelease2: Not releasing from {team}. The tackler has to let go first.
comm.off_notRoll1: Penalty. {player} hasn't rolled away, lying on the wrong side.
comm.off_notRoll2: {team} penalised for not rolling away. Killing the ball.
comm.off_highTackle1: Penalty: high tackle from {player}, contact with the head. The referee is happy it's nothing more.
comm.off_highTackle2: That tackle from {team} was high. Penalty, and a word about the height.
comm.off_scrumCollapse1: Penalty at the scrum: {player} brings it down.
comm.off_scrumCollapse2: The {team} scrum goes backwards and down. Penalty for collapsing.
comm.off_scrumAngle1: Penalty at the scrum: {player} boring in on the angle.
comm.off_scrumAngle2: {team} penalised at the scrum for not pushing straight.
comm.off_scrumBind1: Penalty at the scrum: {player} has lost the bind.
comm.off_scrumBind2: Bind slipped in the {team} front row, and the referee was looking straight at it.
comm.off_scrumKnee1: Penalty at the scrum: {player} has a knee on the ground.
comm.off_scrumKnee2: Knee on the ground in the {team} front row. Penalty.
comm.off_scrumEarly1: Penalty at the scrum: {player} engaged before the call.
comm.off_scrumEarly2: {team} going early at the scrum. Penalty this time.
comm.off_maulCollapse2: The maul is collapsed by {team}. Penalty, and the referee is not far from a card.
comm.off_lineoutBarge1: Penalty at the lineout: {player} barges into the jumper.
comm.off_lineoutBarge2: {team} penalised for closing the gap at the lineout.
comm.off_lineoutThrough1: Penalty at the lineout: {player} goes through the line into the jumper.
comm.off_lineoutThrough2: {team} penalised for going through the lineout rather than up.
comm.off_lifterAcross1: Penalty at the lineout: {player} drives the jumper across the line into the opposition.
comm.off_lifterAcross2: Illegal lift from {team} - the jumper is shoved across the gap.
comm.off_offsideKick1: Penalty. {player} in front of the kicker and plays the ball. Offside.
comm.off_offsideKick2: {team} offside at the kick - a chaser who never got back behind the ball.
comm.off_boxKick101: Penalty: {player} within ten metres of the catcher at the box kick.
comm.off_boxKick102: {team} within ten metres of the catcher. Penalty at the box kick.
comm.off_pullBack1: Penalty: {player} pulls the ball back into the ruck after it had come out.
comm.off_pullBack2: {team} penalised for playing the ball back into the ruck.
comm.off_beyondRuck1: Penalty: {player} takes out a defender beyond the ruck.
comm.off_beyondRuck2: {team} penalised for clearing out a player nowhere near the ball.
comm.off_noBall1: Penalty against {player}. Tackle off the ball.
comm.off_noBall2: {team} hit a runner who never had the ball. Penalty.
comm.offFullArm: That's twice at the scrum. Not a free kick this time: full-arm penalty.
comm.refWarn1: The referee calls {player} over: {n} penalties against {team}, and the next one is a card.
comm.refWarn2: A word with {player}. The penalty count is climbing and {team} have been told.
comm.refWarn3: "Captain, it's a team warning now." {player} relays it to the {team} forwards.
comm.refWarnFinal: Final warning to {player}: one more penalty and another {team} player goes to the bin.
comm.capTalk1: {player} wants a word with the referee about the breakdown.
comm.capTalk2: {player} asks the referee what {team} need to do differently. "Stay on your feet, Captain."
comm.capTalk3: "Speak to me, not them" - the referee to the {team} players crowding round {player}.
comm.reverse_obstruction: Decision reversed: {team} ran a blocker in front of the ball. Penalty to {opp} instead.
comm.reverse_screen: The big screen shows it: {team} offended first. Penalty reversed, to {opp}.
comm.reverse_touchJudge: Late flag from the touch judge. It was {team} who offended, and the penalty goes the other way, to {opp}.
comm.cyn_knockDown: {player} slaps the pass down with the line begging. Deliberate, and the referee knows it.
comm.cyn_ruck: {player} lies all over the ball to stop {opp} scoring. Cynical.
comm.cyn_maul: The {opp} maul is going over and {player} pulls it down.
comm.ycPenTry: PENALTY TRY, and {player} goes to the bin for the foul that stopped it.
comm.ycProfFoul: Yellow card for {player}: a professional foul inside the 22.
comm.penTry1: PENALTY TRY to {team}! The referee runs under the posts. Seven points, no conversion needed.
comm.penTry2: The referee is in no doubt. Penalty try to {team}: they'd have scored.
comm.penTry3: Under the posts goes the referee: penalty try to {team}.
comm.tryIntercept1: INTERCEPT! {player} picks it off and is gone. Nobody's catching that. TRY!
comm.tryIntercept2: {player} jumps the pass and runs the length of the field. Intercept try!
comm.tryIntercept3: Picked off! {player} takes the floated ball on the run and goes all the way. TRY!
comm.tryIntercept4: A fourteen-point swing: {player} intercepts and scores at the other end.
comm.interceptCaught1: {player} picks off the pass - but is hauled down from behind before the line.
comm.interceptCaught2: Intercepted by {player}! A long run, and the cover just gets there in time.
comm.heldUp1: HELD UP! {carrier} is over the line but {player} gets underneath it.
comm.heldUp2: Over the line, but the ball never touches the grass - {player} is under it. Held up.
comm.heldUp3: {carrier} drives for the line and is held up. Great work from {player} and the {team} defence.
comm.gldo1: Goal-line drop-out to {team}. Out of jail.
comm.gldo2: {team} restart with a drop-out from their own goal line, and clear the danger.
comm.fk_mark: Mark! {player} calls it inside the 22 and {team} have a free kick.
comm.fk_scrumEarly: Free kick to {team} - {opp} went early at the scrum.
comm.fk_lineoutNumbers: Free kick to {team}: {opp} had too many in the lineout.
comm.fk_scrumFeed: Free kick to {team}. The {opp} put-in was not straight.
comm.fk_delay: Free kick to {team} for time-wasting at the set piece. The referee wants it formed.
comm.fk_lineoutGap: Free kick to {team} - {opp} closed the gap in the lineout.
comm.notStraight1: Not straight! {player} misses the middle of the tunnel and {opp} take the scrum.
comm.notStraight2: The {team} throw is crooked. Scrum to {opp}.
comm.notStraightCold: Not straight - {player}, on from the bench, has not found the range yet. Scrum to {opp}.
comm.tmoFoul_high: Play has gone on, but the TMO wants a look at a high tackle from {player}.
comm.tmoFoul_secondary: The TMO has flagged it: secondary contact to the head from {player}.
comm.tmoFoul_neckRoll: The TMO calls it back: a neck roll at the ruck by {player}.
comm.tmoFoul_cleanout: The TMO is checking a dangerous clean-out from {player}, straight into the head.
comm.tmoFoul_ballOnGround: The TMO has seen something: {player} playing the ball on the ground out of the tackle.
comm.tmoMit_dip: Mitigation: the carrier dipped into the tackle. Penalty only.
comm.tmoMit_fall: The carrier was falling into it, which is the mitigation. Penalty, no card.
comm.tmoMit_late: A late change of direction from the carrier. The referee settles on a penalty.
comm.tmoMit_low: Low degree of danger, the referee decides. A penalty, and that is all.
comm.ycTmo: Yellow card for {player} after the review.
comm.ycBallOnGround: Yellow card for {player}: playing the ball on the floor, cynical and right in front of the referee.
comm.rcTmo: RED CARD for {player}. No mitigation, and {team} are a player down for the rest of it.
comm.scuffle1: Afters! {player} shoves an opponent after the whistle and both packs pile in.
comm.scuffle2: Tempers flare. {player} and an opponent nose to nose, and everyone joins in.
comm.scuffle3: A scuffle by the ruck. {player} started it, and the referee knows it.
comm.scuffleNothing: The referee calls the captains in. Nothing given, a final word, and on we go.
comm.scufflePen: The referee has seen who started it: penalty against {team} for {player}'s shove.
comm.ycScuffle: And {player} is in the bin for it. Ten minutes to cool down.
comm.waterBreak1: Water break. A hot afternoon, and both sides need it.
comm.waterBreak2: Second water break. The heat is starting to tell on {home} and {away}.
comm.hotDay: A hot one today. Water breaks at the quarters, and the legs will go early.
comm.lateWithdrawal: Late change for {team}: {player} pulls out in the warm-up, and {sub} starts.
comm.outFull1: {player} sends it out on the full. Lineout back where it was kicked.
comm.outFull2: Out on the full from {player}. A wasted kick, and {opp} throw in.
comm.outFull3: That has not bounced - out on the full, and {team} give the ground straight back.
comm.void5022: It looked like a 50:22 for {player}, but the ball was taken back into the half first. Lineout to {opp}.
comm.fifty22_1: 50:22! {player} bounces it into touch inside the {opp} 22. {team} throw in.
comm.fifty22_2: A perfect 50:22 from {player}. From their own half to the {opp} 22 in one kick.
comm.fifty22_3: {player} finds the corner from inside the half - 50:22, and the throw is {team}'s.
comm.quickThrow1: {player} takes the quick throw before the lineout is formed, and {team} are away.
comm.quickThrow2: Quick throw from {player}! The {opp} defence is still walking back.
comm.penPost1: {player}'s penalty hits the post and bounces back into play.
comm.penPost2: Off the upright! {player} is inches away.
comm.conPost: {player}'s conversion clips the post and stays out.
comm.dropMiss6: {player} drops for goal - off the post!
comm.shotClock1: The shot clock has run out on {player}. Scrum to {opp} - no kick at all.
comm.shotClock2: Too slow: the sixty seconds are up before {player} kicks, and the chance is gone.
comm.hiaMouthguard: The smart mouthguard has flagged a big impact: {player} off for a Head Injury Assessment, {sub} on.
comm.tmoReview5: {team} are over - but the TMO is checking for offside at the kick in the build-up.
comm.tmoReview6: Try for {team}? The TMO wants to look at a blocker in the build-up.
comm.tmoReview7: {team} think they have scored, but the TMO is going back through the phases to the lineout.
comm.tmoNoTry5: NO TRY! A {team} chaser was in front of the kicker and played the ball. Offside - penalty to the defence.
comm.tmoNoTry6: NO TRY! Obstruction in the build-up - a {team} runner screened the tackler. Penalty to the defence.
comm.tmoNoTry7: NO TRY! The TMO found a {team} player offside at the lineout, several phases back. Penalty to the defence.
comm.haka1: The haka. {team} lay down the challenge, and {opp} stand and face it.
comm.haka2: Silence, then the haka. {opp} hold the line and stare it down.
comm.haka3: {team} perform the haka, and {opp} edge forward to meet it. The noise is enormous.
comm.ycHigh: Yellow card - {player} for a high tackle. Ten minutes.
comm.ycKnockOn: Yellow card - {player} for a deliberate knock-on.
comm.ycOffsideRepeat: Yellow card - {player} offside again, and the referee has run out of patience.
comm.ycShoulder: Yellow card - {player} led with the shoulder.
comm.ycTrip: Yellow card - {player} stuck out a foot. Ten minutes.
comm.etStart: Level at {hs}-{ascore} after eighty minutes: {home} and {away} go to extra time, two periods of ten.
comm.etTry: Extra-time try for {team}! The conversion is missed.
comm.etTryCon: Extra-time try for {team}, and it is converted!
comm.etTurn: The teams turn round for the second period of extra time: {hs}-{ascore}.
comm.etOnTries: Still level after extra time at {hs}-{ascore}. {team} go through on tries scored, {n} to {m}.
comm.etKicksStart: Level on points and on tries: {home} and {away} go to a place-kick competition.
comm.etKicksWon: {team} win the place-kick competition {n}-{m} and go through.
comm.etKicksSudden: Sudden death in the place-kick competition, and {team} win it {n}-{m}!
comm.penKickableAsk: PENALTY to {team} - kickable range. The captain looks to the touchline for the call...
comm.dropMiss1: {player} drops for goal, but it slides wide of the posts.
comm.dropMiss2: Drop goal attempt from {player}... and it is wide. Twenty-two drop-out.
comm.dropMiss3: {player} goes for the drop goal and snatches at it. No good.
comm.dropMiss4: {player} tries a snap drop from the pocket. It falls short and is touched down.
comm.dropMiss5: Up goes the drop goal from {player}... it hits the upright and bounces away!
comm.yellowCard: Yellow card - {player} to the bin for ten.
comm.hiaFailed: {player} has failed his HIA. No further part in this one, and {sub} stays on.
comm.hiaPassed: {player} passes his HIA and is back on.
comm.hiaLedAway: {player} is led away for a Head Injury Assessment - {sub} on while the doctors do their work.
comm.fun1: A dog has made it onto the pitch and is being chased by two stewards and a very keen {team} replacement. The dog is winning.
comm.fun2: The ball smacks the referee square in the back. Play on, says the referee, as if nothing whatsoever happened.
comm.fun3: {player} calls for the ball, gets it, and looks genuinely surprised about it.
comm.fun4: A seagull lands on the halfway line and stays for two phases. Nobody asks it to move.
comm.fun5: The stadium announcer reads out a lost car key. Half the {team} bench checks their pockets.
comm.fun6: {player} loses a boot in the tackle and plays three phases with one on. The boot gets a round of applause when it comes back.
comm.howler1: {player} drops it over the line with the try begging! White-line fever.
comm.howler2: {player} kicks it dead from halfway, and there was nothing on. The coach can't watch.
comm.howler3: Oh no - {player} throws a wild offload straight to the opposition. Cheap turnover.
comm.howler4: {player} misses the restart completely. One bounce and into touch.
comm.howler5: {player} showboats before grounding it... and the cover knocks it loose! Oh dear.
comm.halfTimeNumbers: First-half numbers: possession {hposs}%-{aposs}%, tries {htries}-{atries}, penalty goals {hpens}-{apens}.
comm.hourMark: Hour gone, and a break in play. Time for changes from the touchline.
comm.doesWidth: push their wings out to meet it, and commit fewer to the ruck.
comm.seesMiddle: everything is coming through the middle
comm.doesMiddle: stack the breakdown and dare the ball to go wide.
comm.doesAerial: drop a man deep and keep the back three home.
comm.doesPace: slow everything - every scrum reset, every mark, every tying of a bootlace.
comm.doesPhysical: refuse the scrap, keep fifteen on the field and let the referee do the tidying.
comm.doesPassive: raise the tempo and force the game to be played.
comm.coachChases: {who} has seen enough. Bench emptied, and {team} will run everything from here.
comm.coachManages: {who} wants it in the corners now. {team} will play for territory and run the clock down.
comm.subUndoneNamed: Change of heart on the touchline: {off} stays on and {on} sits back down.
comm.subUndone: Change of heart on the touchline: {off} stays on and the replacement sits back down.
comm.shirtSwap: Positional switch for {team}: {a} and {b} swap shirts.
comm.forfeit: Walkover: {loser} could not raise a side. {winner} take the match 28-0.
comm.uncontestedNow: {team} have lost {player} from the front row with nobody trained to cover: the referee orders UNCONTESTED SCRUMS from here. No shove, no scrum penalties.
comm.uncontestedShort: And it costs {team} a second player: under Law 3.20 a side that goes uncontested through a card must take another man off. {player} makes way.
comm.contestedAgain: The front-rower is back from the bin and so is the cover: the referee restores CONTESTED SCRUMS.
comm.frontRowReturns: The bench is spent, so {player} comes back on: a replaced front-rower may return for an injured one, and the scrum stays a contest.
comm.frontRowBinCover: {lost} is in the bin and {team} need a trained front row, so under Law 3 {on} comes on and {player} leaves the field to make way until the ten minutes are up. The scrum stays a contest.
comm.frontRowRedCover: {lost} is gone for the match and {team} need a trained front row, so under Law 3 {on} comes on and {player} leaves the field to make way for the rest of it. The scrum stays a contest, and {team} are still a player down.
comm.frontRowBinBack: {lost} is back from the bin and takes the front-row shirt back from {on}, who returns to the bench; {player} comes back on too.
comm.testimonial_f: {player}'s testimonial. She leads them out with her kids, and the whole ground is on its feet. Then the whistle goes and it's a game of rugby again.
comm.oldBoy_f: A familiar face out there: {player} lines up against {oldClub}, where she made {n} appearances. {tail_k}
comm.oldBoyKnowsThem_f: She knows this opposition inside out.
comm.milestoneApps_f: Career appearance number {n} for {player} today. Warm applause as she comes out of the tunnel.
comm.try9_f: TRY! {player} arcs outside her marker and won't be caught!
comm.try11_f: TRY! What a fend from {player}! Strolls in.
comm.try18_f: TRY! {player} bounces off three of them, and in she goes!
comm.try19_f: TRY! {player} shows and goes. Nobody within five metres of her!
comm.try21_f: TRY! {player} straightens, sits the last defender down and strolls over!
comm.try22_f: TRY! In comes the blindside wing, and it's {player} who goes over!
comm.pen5_f: {player} takes her time... and drills it.
comm.pen11_f: {player} wipes the mud off the ball, wipes the rain off her face, and nails it.
comm.flavGrass4_f: Huge cheer from the clubhouse balcony as {player} flattens her opposite number. Someone rings the bell.
comm.flavPac6_f: One-handed take above her head from {player}, under pressure, in traffic. No notes.
comm.flav12_f: Choke tackle! {player} holds her up and it's a {team} scrum.
comm.flav22_f: {player} throws a cut-out pass that misses three women - vision, that.
comm.flavDerby5_f: {player} and her opposite number exchange words at the lineout. Neither is discussing the weather.
comm.tired1_f: {player} has her hands on her knees. Running on fumes.
comm.tired4_f: Cramp for {player} - she waves away the physio, but the legs have gone.
comm.trySeasonCount_f: Try number {n} this season for {player}. She's flying.
comm.tryAtTestimonial_f: Who else? {player} scores at her own testimonial, and nobody in the ground is sitting down.
comm.tryNoCelebration_f: No celebration from {player} against her old club. Hands up, almost apologetic. Still counts.
comm.tryRetiringOvation_f: The whole ground is on its feet for {player}, both ends. She retires in the summer. They'll remember that one.
comm.tryComeback_f: {player}, back from injury, scores. All those weeks of rehab for that. Look at her face.
comm.heavyKnock_f: {player} took a heavy knock there. Waves the physio away, but she's moving gingerly.
comm.injuryDown_f: {player} is down and can't carry on: {injury_k}.{rush_k}
comm.injuryRushedBack_f: She was rushed back too soon.
comm.briefImpact_f: She's on to run at them.
comm.briefShore_f: She's on to shut up shop.
comm.briefManage_f: She's on to kick for the corners and run the clock down.
comm.hiaFailed_f: {player} has failed her HIA. No further part in this one, and {sub} stays on.
comm.hiaPassed_f: {player} passes her HIA and is back on.
comm.doesAerial_f: drop a woman deep and keep the back three home.
comm.uncontestedShort_f: And it costs {team} a second player: under Law 3.20 a side that goes uncontested through a card must take another woman off. {player} makes way.
comm.oppCoachNamed_w: {coach} has done her homework: {team} are set up to stop {pattern_k}. Change the picture, or play through it.
comm.oppCoach_w: The opposition coach has done her homework: {team} are set up to stop {pattern_k}. Change the picture, or play through it.
comm.advPlaying: The arm stays out - advantage {team}, and the whistle never comes...
comm.advOver: Advantage {team}, played to the end of it, and the referee waves it away. Three points gone.
comm.koDamp: A greasy surface after the morning's rain.
comm.uncontestedNoRep: And under Law 3 the player whose departure caused it cannot be replaced: {team} take {player} off and play on with fourteen.
comm.uncontestedBin: And under Law 3 {team} lose a second player while {lost} sits out the ten minutes: {player} goes off too, and the two come back together.
comm.specProp: {player} packs down at prop for {team} without the training for it: the scrum will creak.
comm.specHook: {player} is at hooker for {team} and has never thrown in: the lineout will suffer.
comm.specNine: {player} is at scrum-half for {team}, and it shows: the service from the base is slow.

touch.gambleEmpty: Held up. Nothing from the corner this time.
touch.pinnedNoPoints: No points yet, but you have them pinned.
touch.quickTapWorks: The quick tap catches them asleep. Try!
touch.tempoLifted: No try, but they are going backwards.
touch.notInStartingXV: That player is not in the starting side.
touch.inTheBin: He is in the sin bin - the ten minutes must be served before that shirt can change.
touch.notOnPitch: He is not on the pitch.
touch.tooLateToUndo: Too late to take that back.
touch.frontRowOnly: That shirt needs a trained front-rower, and the bench still has one.
touch.bothInXV: Both players must be in the XV.
touch.bothOnPitch: Both players must be on the pitch.
touch.inTheBin_f: She is in the sin bin - the ten minutes must be served before that shirt can change.
touch.notOnPitch_f: She is not on the pitch.

dec.analystRight: Backed the analyst's strongest read at {opp} ({unit_k}): he had it right, and it showed.
dec.analystWrong: Backed the analyst's strongest read at {opp} ({unit_k}): he was wrong, and the week was wasted.
dec.praisedOutOfForm: Praised {player} while he was out of form. He took it as a wind-up.
dec.warnedInForm: Warned {player} while he was in form. The room noticed.
dec.quietWord: A quiet word with {player} about his form.

signedSponsor.one: Signed {sponsor} for the {slot_k}: {weekly} a week over one season.
signedSponsor.other: Signed {sponsor} for the {slot_k}: {weekly} a week over {n} seasons.

dec.scoutBrief: Sent {scout} out on a {months}-month brief: {fee} of expenses, report in {weeks} weeks.
dec.scoutBriefBack: The {months}-month brief came back with {n} {names_k}, {good} of them worth signing. Best: {best}.
dec.appealUpheld: Appealed {player}'s red card: upheld, a match knocked off the ban.
dec.appealDismissed: Appealed {player}'s red card: dismissed, a match added and the board unimpressed.
dec.agreedLoan: Agreed to {player}'s loan request. He goes out for the season.
dec.campHeat: Warm-weather camp: {cost} spent, squad sharpness up 12 and a tighter dressing room.
dec.campHome: Community week at home: nothing spent, the terraces 6 points warmer.
dec.campTour: Sponsor's tour: {fee} banked, the squad 8% flatter and the fans 3 points cooler.
dec.stanceHigh: Set the bar high at the season launch: judge us in May.{fund_k}
dec.warChest: The board released a {fund} war chest.
dec.stanceSafe: Talked the season down at the launch: heads down, no promises.
dec.stanceBoard: Backed the board's targets at the season launch.
dec.facilityDeclined: Asked the board for a level {lvl} {fac_k}: declined, {why_k}.
dec.facilityApproved: Won board backing for a level {lvl} {fac_k}: {cost}, a {weeks}-week build.
dec.expandApproved: Put {seats} new seats at {stadium} out to build for {cost}: {weeks} weeks on site.
dec.appointedStaff: Appointed {name} as {role_k} ({badge_k} badge): {fee} compensation, {wage} a week.{out_k}
dec.badgePassed: {name} passed his {badge_k} badge: a better {role_k}, and {wage} a week now.
dec.badgeFailedFee: {name} failed his {badge_k} badge. The {fee} is gone and he cannot resit for a month.
dec.badgeFailedCourse: {name} failed his {badge_k} badge. The course fee is gone and he resits in four weeks.
dec.movedToTransferBudget: Moved {amount} from the bank into the transfer budget.
dec.charter: The Owner's Charter signed: the salary cap no longer applies to the club.

heal.one: Booked the specialist retreat: one player restored to full health
heal.other: Booked the specialist retreat: {n} players restored to full health

dec.estate: Built every facility to the top level in one go
dec.pinnacle: Sent my name to the federations
dec.boardPushed: Pressed the board after a refusal: formal warning, respect halved.
dec.fundsApproved: Asked the board for extra transfer funds: {amount} granted.
dec.fundsDeclined: Asked the board for extra transfer funds: declined.
dec.dreamRefocus: Realised a dream and named a new one: to {dream_k}.
dec.sponsorWalked: Pushed {sponsor} too far over the {slot_k}: they walked out.
dec.praisedOutOfForm_f: Praised {player} while she was out of form. She took it as a wind-up.
dec.warnedInForm_f: Warned {player} while she was in form. The room noticed.
dec.quietWord_f: A quiet word with {player} about her form.
